title: Ivo and the Cipher
author: Theo Halloran
blurb: Theo Blackwood, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
